metadata.description: Watch your own Claude Code sessions as a 3D constellation in the lab at diegobianqui.com/lab/constellation. Only the shape of the activity leaves your computer's relay, never text.

plugins.name: agent-constellation
plugins.description: Connects your local Claude Code sessions to the agent constellation lab: background hooks and a relay on 127.0.0.1 that pass on the shape of the activity (agents, tools, timings, token counts), never prompts, replies, commands or paths.
